Current report contains 882 entries / 823 unique images; 286 unique images have review evidence and 537 remain unreviewed, so status remains REVIEW_REQUIRED.
visual_review.observations: The voice lifecycle at 320/390px keeps participant cards, join/leave, mute/deafen/share and pending/recovery actions reachable; denied-microphone copy wraps above the fixed dock actions. At actual browser zoom the enlarged cards and dock remain visible; a transient focus hint can overlap a card edge but not the microphone control. Sharing cards can begin below the dock until the room is scrolled; focused tests verify full scroll clearance at 320/390px. Audio diagnostic controls and values stay in their panels at 320/390px and actual browser zoom; at enlarged text the form remains in vertical flow. Long selected native device labels can still truncate with ellipses, while full options appear when the select opens. The 1024px header contains its title/subtitle; authenticated 393px and 1440px screen-share/voice states retain their actions and recovery controls. Preview video is synthetic and does not prove physical picker or media quality. Control-consistency captures at 320/390px and at 200% text/browser zoom keep buttons, archive forms and file actions within the viewport; controls wrap and archive content scrolls vertically. Some native select values truncate with ellipses; full choices remain available in the native menu. Eight additional source-resolution captures were reviewed: narrow archive and mention surfaces remain within their viewport; long channel titles yield before header actions; the 780px/200% voice prejoin keeps both actions visible; the 393px and 1440px real-stack mention views preserve workspace, filters and composer; the 1024px search panel fits its four modes; and the keyboard-state dock has no action overlap. The selected native archive channel label is visibly truncated, consistent with the recorded note that the open native menu exposes its full value.
